items.title: Nuclear aur particle physics: ta'aruf (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening (PDF 138, printed 134).

blocks.text: 1911 mein Ernest Rutherford ke experiments (tajurbaat) se pata chala ke atom ke beech mein ek bohat chhota, dense (ghana, bohat bhara hua) aur positive charge wala hissa hai, jise nucleus kehte hain, aur us ke gird electrons hain. 1920 mein Rutherford ne kaha ke nucleus ka positive charge protons ki wajah se hai, aur ek aise particle ki prediction (pehle se khabar dena) bhi ki jis par koi charge na ho. Yeh prediction 1932 mein sach sabit hui jab James Chadwick ne neutron discover (daryaft) kiya.

Nuclear physics atomic nuclei aur sub-atomic (atom se chhote) particles ke alag alag pehluon ki study (parhai) hai. Is chapter mein hum khaas taur par yeh parhenge: unstable (kamzor, toot jane wale) nuclei jo radiation chhorte hain, un ka decay (toot kar doosri cheez banna), aur fission aur fusion jaise nuclear reactions jo bohat zyada energy de kar insanon ko faida dete hain. Mukhtalif elements ke radioactive isotopes medical diagnosis (bimari ki pehchan) aur treatment (ilaj), agriculture (kheti-baari), scientific research (tehqeeq) aur industry mein tracers ke taur par istemal hote hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: α-particles ke scattering (bikharne) wale experiments se Lord Rutherford ne conclusion (nateeja) nikala ke atom ka zyada tar hissa khali hai aur us ka mass ek bohat chhoti jagah mein jama hai jise nucleus kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Atom ke centre (beech) mein chhota positive nucleus (+), jis ke gird chaar aik doosre ko kaatte elliptical (anday jaise) orbits (chakkar ke raste) par aath negative electrons hain; nucleus par 'Positive nucleus' likha hai.
blocks.caption: Kya aap jante hain? box: electrons se ghira positive nucleus (kitab ke box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Atomic nucleus ko symbol ᴬZX se likhte hain (A oopar, Z neeche, X ke baen taraf); ise aksar nuclide kehte hain. X element ka chemical symbol hai. Z atomic ya charge number hai jo protons ki ginti (number) batata hai. A mass number hai jo nucleons (protons + neutrons) ki kul ginti batata hai. Nucleus mein neutrons ki ginti N = A − Z hai. Is tarah hydrogen, carbon aur uranium ko ¹₁H, ¹²₆C aur ²³⁵₉₂U likhte hain. Nucleus bohat dense hai aur us ka radius 10⁻¹⁴ m ke order (lag bhag itna) ka hai; us ke gird electrons ka cloud (badal) hai, aur atom ka radius 10⁻¹⁰ m ke order ka hai, yani atom nucleus se taqreeban das hazar guna bara hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'cloud of elections' chhapti hai; murad electrons ka badal hai.

blocks.prompt: Uranium-235 (Z = 92) ke nucleus mein kitne protons aur neutrons hain?
blocks.explanation: 92 protons aur N = A − Z = 235 − 92 = 143 neutrons.

items: Nuclide ᴬZX: A = nucleons, Z = protons, N = A − Z.
Nucleus ka radius taqreeban 10⁻¹⁴ m; atom ka taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m.
